04 Food & fuel

Where to eat,
where to fill.

Researched stops along each day’s actual route, with vegetarian and non-vegetarian notes for the whole crew and van-friendly fuel before every early start. Everything also appears on the day’s map.

Hours in this remote region change seasonally and some kitchens close early — call ahead for dinner, especially with a party of 11. In-park dining is run by official concessioners (Vail/GTLC and Xanterra).

07 Packing list

Pack once,
worry never.

A researched checklist for August in Grand Teton and Yellowstone — dawn wildlife runs, high-altitude sun and eleven people in one van. Checked items save on this device.

Built from NPS “10 Essentials” guidance and Yellowstone-specific packing sources. Bear spray cannot fly in any luggage — buy in Jackson or rent at Canyon Village.
